title: Guard log
summary: Every call your agents made to PayPal and what the guard did with it. Held and stopped calls never reached PayPal.

chain.tampered: Black box tampered: row #{row} {reason}. Entries from there on cannot be trusted.
chain.intact: Black box intact, {count, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}}
chain.howChain: Every row carries the hash of the one before it, so an edited, reordered or deleted row breaks the chain.
chain.howCheck: New rows are checked on every visit, older ones in full at least once a minute.
chain.howHead: A log rewritten from scratch would also chain: keep a copy of the head {head}… elsewhere to catch that.

tally.waiting: {count, plural, one {waits for you} other {wait for you}}

download.label: Download {format}
download.title: Every decision of the guard, with who decided it. Emails and cards are masked.

error.title: We couldn't load this PayPal data
error.detail: Check the API credentials in {file}, and that the sandbox app has the features this endpoint needs.

held.title: Waiting for your approval
held.intro: Approving runs the call through the guard’s checks again before PayPal sees it.
held.heading: {action}{hasAmount, select, yes { of {amount}} other {}} for {customer}
held.failed: The decision could not be processed; nothing was recorded.

assistant.title: Ask about these decisions
assistant.intro: Ask about the guard's decisions. It reads the newest entries of the log, masked and without the tickets' text, and can only explain: it can't approve, reject or change rules.

suggestions.lastRefund: Why was the last refund blocked?

assistant.unreachable: The guard assistant could not be reached.

liveMode.on: Live mode is on: calls from your shop's app move real money.
liveMode.failClosed: Live mode is turned on, but this server runs in test mode: every call uses the sandbox.
